title.narrative: Sustainable Saquarema: Innovation and Participation for a Better Urban Future for All

description.narrative:
This project goal is to establish a comprehensive and integrated framework in the municipality of Saquarema that effectively coordinates and implement SDG-aligned public policies, ensuring sustainable urban development and improved quality of life for all citizens.
To achieve the proposed goal, the municipal Government of Saquarema proposes a partnership with the United Nations Programme for Human Settlements (UN-Habitat) focused on the following:
Outcome: By 2026, the municipal government of Saquarema is equipped to develop evidence-based public policies aligned with the SDGs
The project comprises seven key outputs: 1.1 Communication, mobilization, and visibility campaign implemented, to increase public awareness and engagement; 1.2 Socioeconomic survey of Saquarema's population aligned with the SDGs conducted, to inform policy decisions; 1.3 Saquarema Public Policy Observatory in place, for ongoing monitoring and analysis ; 1.4 Saquarema's Voluntary Local Review (VLR) elaborated, demonstrating the city progress towards SDG targets and giving a baseline to guide municipal actions; 1.5 Capacity building program for municipal staff implemented, to train Saquarema municipal professionals on how to use the developed products, especially the Observatory, and on global agendas to better incorporate best practices and guidance; and
These outputs will be delivered through a series of activities including data collection, analysis, platform development, report writing, and capacity building. The project emphasizes community engagement, data-driven decision-making, and alignment with global sustainability agendas. The first output involves creating a communication, mobilization, and visibility campaign to engage the community and raise awareness about the project. This campaign will utilize various communication channels, including local radio stations, social media, and informational sessions, to disseminate key messages and encourage social participation. The campaign will also include the development of materials such as booklets and technical notebooks focused on SDGs, urban planning, and the New Urban Agenda.
The second output is a socioeconomic survey of Saquarema's population aligned with the SDGs. This comprehensive survey will collect essential data on living conditions, income, education, housing, and access to public services. The data collection process will involve creating a standardized questionnaire incorporating SDG-related indicators relevant to Saquarema and training a field team to ensure efficient and accurate data collection. The survey will use tablets with GPS and ArcGIS software for secure data storage and transmission. The collected data will be analyzed using statistical tools to identify patterns and trends among socioeconomic variables and their association with the SDGs.
The third output is the creation of a Saquarema Public Policy Observatory. This observatory will align and monitor actions, projects, and programs developed by the municipality with international sustainable development agendas. It will gather indicators from various spheres and measure the municipality's performance in reducing inequalities, guided by the SDGs.
The fourth output is the development of Saquarema's Voluntary Local Review (VLR) of the SDGs. This process will involve capacity building and technical support in preparing the VLR, following the methodology developed by UN-Habitat and United Cities and Local Governments (UCLG). The review will be comprehensive and participatory, involving different sectors of society and aligning local policies with global goals.
The fifth output is a training program for Saquarema Municipality professionals on global agendas, communication, and use of the developed products. This program aims to create a common knowledge base regarding the guidelines of the products and strengthen local capacities to implement works that follow the precepts established in the products and global agendas. The training will focus on the presentation and use of the Observatory, communication strategies, and initiatives for localizing SDGs.
Through these interconnected outputs, the project aims to equip Saquarema with the tools, knowledge, and capacity to effectively implement and monitor sustainable development initiatives, fostering a more inclusive and urban environment.
